sentences.text: No, the documents do not support a 4% foreclosure charge for this case; for all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, with or without co-obligant(s), a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges, and this applies to loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026. [E5]
The case facts are a floating-rate loan to an individual for a non-business purpose, sanctioned on 2026-01-01, so paragraph 261(1) covers it. [E5]
The documents do not state any foreclosure charge amount for this case, because the applicable direction says no pre-payment charges shall be levied. [E5]

missing.searched: Whether a 4% foreclosure charge applies to this floating-rate, individual, non-business loan sanctioned on 2026-01-01
